adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `Post.cook` early-returning `raw` when `cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` (app/models/post.rb), explicitly skipping the normal cooking/rendering pipeline (which is where sanitization would typically occur). Feed import (`Jobs::PollFeed`) passes `i.content` from RSS/ATOM into `TopicEmbed.import` and creates posts with `cook_method: :raw_html`, and the embed view renders with `<%= raw post.cooked %>` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb). Neither the RSS path nor `TopicEmbed.import_remote`’s readability filtering shows any explicit sanitization or scheme filtering (e.g., `javascript:` in `href/src`), so untrusted HTML can be stored and rendered as-is, enabling XSS.
